content.short: ScaleBit is a blockchain security firm that audits smart contracts, dapps, and core infrastructure for multichain teams.
content.description: ScaleBit is the blockchain security arm of BitsLab and focuses on security reviews for smart contracts, dapps, bridges, and broader blockchain systems. Its official site highlights formal verification, expert review, and ongoing monitoring, alongside research depth in scaling systems, interoperability, and zero knowledge technology. The firm also presents zkScanner as an automated circuit analysis product, which helps position ScaleBit as both an audit provider and a tooling focused security team for Web3 builders.
content.meta: ScaleBit delivers blockchain audits, formal verification, and security tooling for teams building contracts, dapps, and infrastructure.
